title: The Reflexivity Debate (live dialectic that resolves)
question: Is reflexive awareness intrinsic to experience or a constructed higher-order operation?

candidates.position: cognition is reflexively structured without an enduring self

candidates.author: Ñāṇavīra
candidates.position: experience folds back on itself; identity through transformation

resolution:
Reflexivity is established as a real feature of experience (all four
 candidates agree on the phenomenon). Its nature is contested across three live
 positions: self-grounding structure (Dignāga/Dharmakīrti), vimarśa as ground
 (Abhinavagupta), and groundless reflexivity (Ñāṇavīra). None is defeated. The differences
 may be irreducible — each tradition asks a different question in a different domain.
